tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Off-white paper in light, near-black green in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the generator panel, dialogs and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the QR preview well, code blocks, table stripes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on ground, surface, surface-sunk and mint (10.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper text on ground, surface and surface-sunk (6.2:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes (3.4:1 or more on ground and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: evergreen
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, links, the logo, active states. As text on ground or surface it holds 7.7:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: on-evergreen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an evergreen fill (8.4:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: evergreen-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of evergreen fills; large brand blocks in illustrations.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Soft brand tint: selected rows, the 'Never expires' badge, info panels. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Accent yellow: the dot in the logo, the 'Download' CTA, highlights. A fill only, never text on light grounds. Text on it uses on-signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (10.3:1).

tokens.name: scan-pass
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'Scans' check badge. Always paired with a check icon and the word 'Scans'.

tokens.name: on-scan-pass
tokens.usage: Text and icon on scan-pass (4.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: scan-fail
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'Won't scan' badge and warnings. Orange, not red, and 3:1 lighter than scan-pass in both themes, so it reads without colour vision. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: on-scan-fail
tokens.usage: Text and icon on scan-fail (7.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every interactive element (7.7:1 or more on ground and surface).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: H1 on use-case, guide and alternatives pages.

styles.name: subheading
styles.sample: Print it once. It works forever.
styles.usage: H3, card titles, the one-line promise under an H1.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your code points straight at your link. No trial, no expiry date, no fine print.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, badges, buttons in dense UI.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Short links, slugs, hex values, file sizes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gap inside form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags, colour swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the generator panel, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The QR preview well and hero media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges: Static, Dynamic, Scans, Never expires.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the generator panel. Use sparingly: borders do most of the separating.
